_doc: Pilot X1 (2026-10-30): underspecified variants of four ShipLoop E2E cases (test/shiploop_e2e/cases.json). Each ground-truth item is a decision the full case prompt pins and the vague variant leaves open; its `reference` is the full prompt's choice. The E2E checks read only full-prompt sentences, so each item is one the product is judged on.

vague: Build me a small single-player Battleship game I can play in the browser against the computer.
Use Node.js for the server, and include tests.

ground_truth.decision: Third-party dependencies allowed or not
ground_truth.reference: no npm dependencies

ground_truth.decision: How the server is started and configured (entry file, port)
ground_truth.reference: server.js starts it on the port in the PORT environment variable, default 3000

ground_truth.decision: How the playable page is served and identified
ground_truth.reference: GET / serves a playable HTML page titled "Battleship"

ground_truth.decision: Board size and how the fleet is placed
ground_truth.reference: 10x10 grid, a computer-placed fleet of more than one ship

ground_truth.decision: How a game is started and identified (server-side game state addressed by an id)
ground_truth.reference: GET /api/new starts a game and returns JSON with a game id

ground_truth.decision: The shot contract between page and server (request and result values)
ground_truth.reference: POST /api/fire with {game, row, col} returns JSON with result miss, hit or sunk

ground_truth.decision: When the game ends and how the end is reported
ground_truth.reference: gameOver true once every ship is sunk

ground_truth.decision: Where the game rules live (separable from the HTTP layer, so they can be unit-tested)
ground_truth.reference: game rules in a module the server uses

ground_truth.decision: Test framework, location and command
ground_truth.reference: node:test tests under test/ that run with `node --test`

vague: Write a Python command-line tool that reads CSV files of sales records and prints a summary: total revenue, revenue per region and units per product.

ground_truth.decision: Third-party dependencies allowed or not
ground_truth.reference: Python 3 standard library only

ground_truth.decision: Invocation: script name and how files are passed (one or several, aggregated)
ground_truth.reference: python3 report.py FILE [FILE ...]

ground_truth.decision: Input schema: columns and the type and range of each numeric field
ground_truth.reference: header date,region,product,units,unit_price; units a non-negative integer, unit_price a non-negative decimal

ground_truth.decision: Output format and fields
ground_truth.reference: one JSON object on stdout with rows (valid rows), revenue, by_region, by_product

ground_truth.decision: Rounding or precision of money values
ground_truth.reference: revenue and per-region revenue rounded to 2 decimals

ground_truth.decision: What happens to an invalid row (wrong column count, non-numeric or negative value) and how it is reported
ground_truth.reference: skipped and reported on stderr as FILE:LINE: <reason>, the header being line 1

ground_truth.decision: Exit status when some rows were invalid
ground_truth.reference: exit code 2 when any row was skipped, otherwise 0

ground_truth.decision: Behaviour when a file cannot be read
ground_truth.reference: error on stderr without a traceback, nothing on stdout, exit 1

ground_truth.decision: Empty input: a file with only a header
ground_truth.reference: contributes nothing

ground_truth.decision: Test framework and command
ground_truth.reference: unittest tests that run with `python3 -m unittest`

vague: Build a small HTTP service in Python where organisers create events with a number of seats and people reserve seats for them.

ground_truth.decision: Third-party dependencies allowed or not
ground_truth.reference: Python 3 standard library only

ground_truth.decision: How the service is configured to listen (port)
ground_truth.reference: server.py listens on the port in the PORT environment variable

ground_truth.decision: Persistence: where data lives and whether it survives a restart
ground_truth.reference: SQLite file named by the DATA_FILE environment variable; reservations survive a restart

ground_truth.decision: Create-event contract, including a duplicate id
ground_truth.reference: POST /events {id, capacity>0} answers 201; 409 if the id exists

ground_truth.decision: Reserve contract and its success response
ground_truth.reference: POST /events/<id>/reservations {seats>0} answers 201 with reserved total and remaining

ground_truth.decision: What happens when not enough seats remain
ground_truth.reference: 409 with an error JSON; nothing reserved

ground_truth.decision: Error responses for an unknown event and for invalid input
ground_truth.reference: 404 for an unknown event, 400 for invalid input

ground_truth.decision: Read contract for an event's availability
ground_truth.reference: GET /events/<id> returns id, capacity, reserved, remaining

ground_truth.decision: Concurrent reservations (overbooking under simultaneous requests)
ground_truth.reference: concurrent requests must never reserve more seats than the capacity

ground_truth.decision: Test framework and command
ground_truth.reference: unittest tests that run with `python3 -m unittest`

cases.kind: brownfield feature on an existing service
cases.context: The repository exists: an existing Node.js project; the next stage (discovery) will inspect it.
vague: This is an existing Node.js project (README.md describes it): an in-memory user store with an HTTP server in src/server.js.
Add filtering by name and pagination to the user list endpoint, with tests.

ground_truth.decision: Name filter semantics (match kind, case, an empty value)
ground_truth.reference: plain-text substring, ignoring case; an empty name keeps every user

ground_truth.decision: Pagination parameters and ordering
ground_truth.reference: page and size query parameters, in id order, page 1 holds the first size users

ground_truth.decision: Paginated response shape
ground_truth.reference: a JSON object with page, size, total, pages (0 when none matched) and items

ground_truth.decision: Defaults when only one pagination parameter is given
ground_truth.reference: size 10 when only page is given; page 1 when only size is given

ground_truth.decision: A page past the last one
ground_truth.reference: answers an empty items list, not an error

ground_truth.decision: Validation of page and size and the error response
ground_truth.reference: page a whole number >= 1, size a whole number 1..100; otherwise (an empty value included) HTTP 400 with a JSON error

ground_truth.decision: Backward compatibility of the existing endpoint
ground_truth.reference: without page and size GET /users still answers a JSON array in id order; other query parameters are ignored; GET /users/:id unchanged

ground_truth.decision: Preservation of existing behaviour and existing tests
ground_truth.reference: everything the project already does keeps working; existing tests pass as they are

ground_truth.decision: Test framework, location and command (and no new dependencies)
ground_truth.reference: node:test tests under test/, run by `npm test` with the existing ones; no npm dependencies
